items.text: Unsalted butter, room temperature before mixing (amount TBD)
Cardamom, bloomed in the brown butter (portion of total — amount TBD)

steps.text: Brown the butter with orange zest until it smells nutty and turns golden-brown. Add a portion of the cardamom to bloom directly in the hot butter.
steps.donenessCue: Butter is deep golden-brown with visible browned milk solids, smells toasted/nutty.

steps.text: Cool the browned butter until it returns to room temperature before mixing into the dough — do not use while warm.
Cream the room-temperature browned butter with the sugar.
Whisk the remaining cardamom into the dry ingredients, then fold into the wet mixture.
Chill the dough for a minimum of 1 hour before baking — do not skip, this is a required step, not optional.
Bake until the edges are golden and the centers are set.
